ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the horizontal axis is time, and the vertical axis is runoff/precipitation; there are two water level hydrographs. The solid line is labeled as "water level hydrograph before urbanization", and the dashed line is labeled as "water level hydrograph after urbanization". Comparing the positions of the highest points of the two curves, the peak of the dashed line is located to the left of the peak of the solid line; the upper part of the figure also shows that the flood peak lag time after urbanization is shorter than the original flood peak lag time. Then reason: the horizontal axis moving to the right indicates the passage of time, and the more the peak is to the left, the earlier the flood peak appears. Therefore, urbanization causes the time of occurrence of the flood peak of the water level hydrograph to advance.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有城市化前后的两条水位过程线，横轴表示时间，虚线为城市化后的曲线，实线为城市化前的曲线。找到两条曲线的最高点并比较其在横轴上的位置：城市化后的虚线峰顶比城市化前的实线峰顶更靠左。因此按时间轴含义可判断，城市化使洪峰出现时间提前。
